$comment:
REQ-RES-001/002 and v1.0 §10. Research is *technology the guild learns*, and it is deliberately not a second experience bar: REQ-RES-002 keeps research and Guild Mastery on separate ledgers, so nothing here is earned by a hunter doing something well. Research points come from the Research department's own output — staffed people in a building, working.

Three branches, per v1.0 §10: Combat, Town and Economy. `conflictsWith` is what makes the tree an identity rather than a checklist — REQ-RES-001 says some choices lock others, so a guild that commits to standing armies cannot also have committed to travelling light. Conflicts are symmetric and validated as such at load; a one-way lock would let the order of research decide what a guild could become.

Every effect is a *named* effect consumed by a real system, never a script. A node whose effect nothing reads would be a node that appears to do something and does not — the failure this whole content pipeline exists to prevent.

branches.combat: What the guild knows about fighting
branches.town: What the guild knows about building and keeping a place
branches.economy: What the guild knows about supplying itself

resetResource.$comment: REQ-RES-001: research can be reset with a rare resource. The resource is authored now and charged when the Phase 7 ledger exists — same treatment as building costs.
resetResource.name: Insight Crystal

The guild is seen in more places.
